video.agency.evidence: [骷髅王·codex] 图1第4行第5–7格（7.00、7.25、7.50秒）：我面前仍有站立且正在逼近、挥臂的敌人，我却连续保持弯腰、刀横斜在身前低处的近似姿态，看不出主动迎击或明确挡击。规格6.8–7.6秒要求我盯着它完成第四刀；这些格子无法确认我正在连贯完成攻击，存在面对威胁停手空等的疑点，按拿不准判fail。；[树人·claude] Judged as the treant, using the 4fps contact sheet (image 1). (1) 0.5–2 s, row 1, frames 0.500–1.750: the spec says the two treants charge at full speed and swing. In the frames they stay about where they started, a few metres to either side of him. They wave their arms, but I can't see either one close in or clearly land a branch on the shield or upper-arm bone. That reads as 'standing still and waiting', which the agency check forbids. (2) 2.8–3.6 s, row 2, frames 02.750–03.750: the spec has the left treant swing back at him. Instead it stands far off at the left edge of the frame with the glowing cut on its body, and I see no counterattack. (3) 5.2–6 s, row 3, frames 05.500–05.750: the left treant is down, and the spec says the right treant should 'charge at him immediately'. It stays planted on the right side at a distance and doesn't move until 06.000. (4) 7.0–7.5 s, row 4, frames 07.000–07.500: after the fourth cut the right treant should stagger and then charge straight back. It stays a short distance away with its arms open and doesn't press in. As the treant, I wait in several beats instead of acting, so this fails.

video.readability.evidence: [audience·claude] Only the overall outcome is clear. In the frames from 9.5s to 12.75s the armored knight with the skull shield and curved sword stands alone, and the tree monsters lie on the ground with orange-glowing wounds, so the knight won. Three things are hard to tell. (1) Who used the skill, and what it is: from 2.75s to 3.5s a red glow sits on the knight's chest and a red light column rises from the ground at his feet. The same red glow covers his body at 4.5s, 6.25s–6.75s and 7.75s–9.0s. A first-time viewer can't tell whether this is the knight's skill or the knight getting hurt. I saw no clear attack shape from cast to target, such as a slash or a shock wave flying out. (2) Who gets hit: from 2.25s on, a small orange glowing spot appears on the left tree monster's waist, but I can't see a frame where a red slash connects with it. Also, the camera is close from 0s to 2s, the shield blocks much of the view, and the tree monsters look alike, so I couldn't follow which one was hit. (3) How the result happens: in the 5.0s frame the left tree monster is still standing, and at 5.25s it is suddenly lying on the ground, with no hit or knockback frame in between. At 9.25s the right tree monster turns into a dark lump and collapses, but the cause is unclear and it looks like it just vanished. The effect is a small red glow on the body, which doesn't match the Vision's 'more dazzling skill'. Overall I can only say 'the knight killed the tree monsters'; I can't say what skill he used or which hit killed which enemy, so this fails.
